known_limitations: RC4-LIM-REC-SEMANTIC-BUNDLE-NOT-DSH-PAYLOAD: Bundle fields are semantic compiler output, not DSH payload bytes.
RC4-LIM-REC-COMPILED-PROMPT-UNSUPPORTED-BY-V17: Accepted V17 did not accept the RC-4 compiled prompt contract.
RC4-LIM-REC-V17-NOT-EXECUTED: RC-4 does not rerun or execute the accepted V17 bridge.
RC4-LIM-REC-CONTEXT-CAPACITY-UNVERIFIED: The registered UTF-8 pilot capacity is not a Recursus or provider context-window claim.
RC4-LIM-REC-PROVIDER-REQUEST-UNOBSERVED: DSH and provider request serialization remain unobserved.

protocol_deviations.detail: Accepted V17 used a minimal bridge input rather than the RC-4 compiled prompt.
Accepted V17 was one nondurable bounded attempt and is not rerun by RC-4.
Accepted V17 preserved a nonreproducible package-order deviation.
Accepted V17 recorded only one bounded summary.
Accepted V17 could not observe the TLS wire request count.
Harness consumption, implicit additions, tool enforcement, file reads, output behavior, usage, and cost are unverified.
Provider request bytes, roles, tokenizer, input tokens, model revision, and context fit are unobserved.

transformation_rules.description: Copy one complete canonical block into one inline route part at the same global ordinal.
Map canonical layers to semantic harness roles without changing authority, trust, order, or content.
Carry the canonical tool profile identity as metadata without claiming DSH or provider encoding.
Add registered configured catalog and output-cap metadata, then discard it during inverse decoding.
